text:
Maria: Hey team — quick sync: we need a simple fallback priority matrix for tenants that request strict residency but we may need to degrade in outages. Goal: minimize legal risk while keeping SLOs. Thoughts?

Ajay: Propose 3 tiers: MUST_RESIDENCY (no cross-region ever), RESIDENCY_PREFERRED (prefer local, can failover to consent-region), BEST_EFFORT (fall back to lowest-latency global).

Lee: How do we model consent-region? It should mean a region that satisfies the tenant's jurisdiction (e.g., eu -> eu-central). Need a header like `X-Residency-Policy: preferred=eu;hard=false`.

Maria: Agree. Also want to capture tenant tier (enterprise vs free). For enterprise we might escalate to human ops before cross-region.

Ravi: Ops cost concern — human-in-loop will blow SLOs. Maybe auto-fallback for low volume, and human review for high-volume failovers.

Sarah: Telemetry requirements: fallback_rate, time_to_fallback, fallback_latency, and legal_exposure_alerts. Set alert when fallback_rate > 0.1% per hour for MUST_RESIDENCY.

Ajay: Quick config example: ```json
{"policy":"RESIDENCY_PREFERRED","preferred_region":"eu-west-1","fallback":["eu-central-1","us-west-2"],"requires_approval":false}
```

Lee: Edge cases: cache/kv keys. If we failover we must mark entries residency-scoped or invalidate them. Otherwise we risk serving stale or noncompliant data.

Maria: Suggestion: namespace caches by <region>:<residency_flag> and include a residency-checksum header on responses to detect mismatches.

OpsBot: Simulation finished — local-serving success 99.92% under 3-zone outage using preferred-fallback matrix. Trace: https://internal/sim/170334 (summary attached).

Ravi: Also map fallback choices to billing flags. Cross-region fallback can add egress + extra model-host cost; show per-tenant cost impact in Console.

Sarah: Action items: (1) draft config schema (Ajay), (2) telemetry events + alerts (Sarah), (3) cache namespacing PR (Lee), (4) ops runbook stub + cost model (Ravi).

Ajay: :thumbsup: will open the RFC draft + initial schema PR today.

Maria: Thanks all — I'll review the RFC. Ping me if you want to be cc'd on enterprise tenants list for approval flows.
